subject: Crosswind — post-call summary & mutual action plan (draft)
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@crosswind.ai>, Tomasz Kowalczyk <tomasz@crosswind.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Crosswind — post-call summary & mutual action plan (draft)

Thanks again for a productive conversation today — summary below and a draft mutual action plan attached for your review (redwood-mpa-draft.xlsx). High-level takeaways and proposed milestones to align on so we can keep momentum: 

Pain points you shared:
- Frequent inference cost spikes and unpredictable tail latency during peak batch scoring (checkout flows).
- Need for private deployment option for PII-sensitive models and strict egress controls.
- Current pilot constraints: limited engineering bandwidth and a tight procurement window (Q3 budget).

Goals for the pilot (what success looks like)
- Baseline: 95th pctl latency <= 180ms for typical 512-token requests, cost <= $0.003/token equivalent.
- Security: environment that meets Crosswind’s egress/KMS requirements and SOC2 evidence.
- Outcome: internal exec decision on a production deployment by 2027-08-01.

Proposed mutual action plan (draft milestones & owners)
1) Sandbox ingest & test data handoff — target: 2027-07-07 — owner: Crosswind eng (Alicia/Tomasz).
2) Pilot infra provision & perf baseline — target: 2027-07-21 — owner: Redwood (Naomi / Marcus).
3) Security & procurement review (evidence exchange: SOC2, retention, KMS) — target: 2027-07-14 — owner: Crosswind procurement + Redwood Security.
4) Executive alignment & go/no-go decision — target: 2027-08-01 — owners: Crosswind execs + Redwood AE.

Decision process and criteria:
- Exec signoff will consider latency/cost targets, security posture, and total cost of ownership projection for first 12 months.

Asks / next steps (please confirm by EOD Tue 2027-06-22):
- Confirm stakeholders above and assign a procurement lead (email) we should include.
- Confirm the sandbox data format (S3 location or Secure FTP) and whether we should provision a VPC peering or use a vaulted staging bucket.
- Review attached draft SOW (Crosswind_SOW_v1.pdf will be circulated in next email) and the MPA spreadsheet; mark any date/owner changes.

I’ll schedule a 30-min follow-up for next week to lock the sandbox handoff window. If this timeline looks good, we’ll draft pricing/terms and route an executive summary for signoff in late July.

Thanks again — excited to get Crosswind into a short, measurable pilot.

—
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Attachments: redwood-mpa-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet - draft milestones)

From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@crosswind.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tomasz Kowalczyk <tomasz@crosswind.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Crosswind — post-call summary & mutual action plan (draft)

Naomi — thanks for the clear recap and the draft MPA. This captures the conversation well. A couple quick items from our side: 

- Procurement contact: procurement@crosswind.ai — please loop them in for the security/evidence exchange.
- Budget / timeline: Execs want a short financial note (estimate for pilot + projected monthly run rate) before the procurement sync; can you include that in the next update?
- Security ask: we need SOC2 Type II docs and a short note on egress controls & KMS model. Are those things Redwood can provide this week?

We’ll confirm the sandbox data format — S3 is preferred for our infra, and we can provide temporary, time-limited grants.

Proposed next call: Tue 2027-07-05 10:00 AM ET for procurement + engineering alignment. Is that feasible?

Thanks — Alicia
Head of Product, Crosswind AI
alicia.ramos@crosswind.ai
Attachments: none

On Mon, Jun 21, 2027 at 09:05 AM Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@crosswind.ai> wrote:
> Quick confirmation: procurement@crosswind.ai is the right contact to add.
> 
> — Alicia

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:31:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Crosswind — post-call summary & mutual action plan (draft)

Naomi — quick internal note. Agree with the milestones. Two technical points to keep in mind for the pilot: 

- Dedicated capacity request: we should propose a 2-week reserved pool (NVIDIA H100 equivalent) for the baseline runs to avoid noisy-neighbor effects.
- Quantization / model variant: propose running the pilot with both full-fp16 and an 8-bit quantized variant to compare cost/quality; will need Crosswind’s acceptance criteria for any quality delta.

I’ll draft a short latency & cost targets paragraph we can paste into the SOW. Naomi — will you own routing that to procurement and add the SOC2 link?

—Marcus
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

From: Tomasz Kowalczyk <tomasz@crosswind.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@crosswind.ai>
Cc: procurement@crosswind.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Crosswind — post-call summary & mutual action plan (draft)

Hi Naomi / Alicia — we reviewed the draft and like the clarity of the milestones. A few items before the procurement sync on 2027-07-05: 

1) Pricing / terms: please send a short pricing worksheet for the pilot (expected token volume ~10M over 30 days) and the expected monthly run-rate estimate if we scale to 10x.
2) SOW comments: attached as Crosswind_SOW_v1.pdf with inline notes (we made small tweaks to the pilot dates).
3) Security evidence: SOC2 and data-retention policy would be great to have before the call — procurement is specifically asking about KMS key ownership and cross-region replication controls.

We can do Tue 2027-07-05 10:00 AM ET — provisional hold on our calendars. If Redwood can provide the SOC2 PDF + a short paragraph on KMS/egress, procurement will prioritize the review.

Also: please include the DocuSign link when the SOW is ready. I expect procurement will do a quick redline pass and then route to execs.

Thanks,
Tomasz
VP Eng, Crosswind AI
tomasz@crosswind.ai
Attachments: Crosswind_SOW_v1.pdf (redlines)

On Wed, Jun 30, 2027 at 09:22 AM Tomasz Kowalczyk <tomasz@crosswind.ai> wrote:
> Attaching our SOW comments and confirming procurement sync for 7/5.
> 
> — Tomasz
